blocks.en: In this subsection we address the question of whether functions in Sobolev spaces can be restricted to the boundary of the domain, or more generally, to other surfaces. We are also interested in the converse question, namely, how smooth boundary data have to be so that a function in $H^k(\Omega)$ can assume those boundary data. We first consider functions defined on $\mathbb{R}^m$ and their restriction to $\mathbb{R}^{m-1}\times\{0\}$.
blocks.zh: 本小节讨论 Sobolev 空间中的函数能否限制到区域的边界, 或更一般地限制到其他曲面的问题. 也关注其逆问题, 即边界数据必须多光滑, 才能由 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中的函数取到这些边界数据. 首先考察定义在 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 上的函数及其在 $\mathbb{R}^{m-1}\times\{0\}$ 上的限制.

blocks.en: A natural question is now which elements of $H^{s-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})$ can be obtained as restrictions, or ``traces'' of functions in $H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$. The answer is that all elements of $H^{s-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})$ are obtained in this way.
blocks.zh: 现在自然会问, $H^{s-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})$ 中哪些元素可作为 $H^s(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中函数的限制, 即 ``迹'' 得到? 答案是 $H^{s-1/2}(\mathbb{R}^{m-1})$ 中的所有元素都可以用这种方式得到.
